summary: Cineverse Corp. disclosed an exchange agreement with OCI-Cinedigm, LLC to retire 3.118 Series A Preferred shares for common stock in five equal tranches starting May 1, 2026, using a 5-day VWAP pricing formula. The company is authorized to issue up to 1.5M common shares. The filing cites Section 3(a)(9) exemption. No premium, advisor, or regulatory timeline is stated. The exchange represents a liability-management capital return, retiring preferred stock. Watch for potential dilution and the pace of tranche exercises, though limited disclosure reduces conviction.
